<json>
{
  "states": [
    "Dead",
    "Establish",
    "Opened",
    "Authenticate",
    "NetworkLayerProtocol",
    "Closing",
    "Terminate",
    "Down"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "Dead",
      "event": "receive Up",
      "action": "open link",
      "to": "Establish"
    },
    {
      "from": "Establish",
      "event": "receive Configure-Ack",
      "action": "set state Opened",
      "to": "Opened"
    },
    {
      "from": "Opened",
      "event": "cond lcp_opened",
      "action": "set state Authenticate",
      "to": "Authenticate"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authenticate",
      "event": "cond auth_complete",
      "action": "set state NetworkLayerProtocol",
      "to": "NetworkLayerProtocol"
    },
    {
      "from": "NetworkLayerProtocol",
      "event": "receive Configure-Request",
      "action": "set state Establish",
      "to": "Establish"
    },
    {
      "from": "NetworkLayerProtocol",
      "event": "receive Terminate-Request",
      "action": "send Terminate-Ack",
      "to": "Closing"
    },
    {
      "from": "Closing",
      "event": "cond network_close",
      "action": "set state Terminate",
      "to": "Terminate"
    },
    {
      "from": "Terminate",
      "event": "signal disconnect",
      "action": "close Link",
      "to": "Down"
    },
    {
      "from": "Opened",
      "event": "fail",
      "action": "set state Dead",
      "to": "Dead"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authenticate",
      "event": "fail",
      "action": "set state Terminate",
      "to": "Terminate"
    }
  ]
}
</json>
